metadata.subject: An AcroForm under a PDF/A-2b claim: the fields' default-resources font is the embedded Latin font (pdfnative 1.8.0)
metadata.keywords: pdfa, pdfa2b, acroform, form, archival, embedded font

blocks.text: PDF/A requires every font a file uses to be embedded — including the font an interactive field draws its value with. Until pdfnative 1.8.0 the fields of a PDF/A document referenced Helvetica, a base-14 font that is never embedded, and veraPDF rejected the file. The form's default resources (/DR) now carry the first embedded font that covers basic Latin.
Rendered with --font latin --lang latin (the pdfa category flags). Without them the render still succeeds but reports PDFA_UNEMBEDDED_FORM_FONT next to PDFA_NO_FONT_ENTRIES, and --strict refuses it.
